note: Declares this skill's deterministic router and generators so skill-forge's blind audit (--blind) can execute eval expectations. router emits JSON to stdout; response_pack_command writes a JSON sidecar consumed by response_pack_json.* assertions; verify_action_command handles verify_action runner evals; release_gate_command builds the per-eval fixture and runs the gate. Expectations use the field-op-value DSL documented in skill-forge/references/evaluation-gate-protocol.md.
